_note: Authoritative English codebook for GEPR-LINAN. Each entry carries a single canonical 'english_label' — this is the only permitted English rendering of the Chinese label in the paper, dataset documentation, README, and all figures. Source of truth for Chinese labels and descriptions: definition.json.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 官署
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 古代政府办公机构。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Civil and military bureaucratic agencies, ministries, courts, and administrative departments.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 行政区划
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 国家划分的管理区域，用于地方治理。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Prefectures, counties, circuits, and other formally delimited territorial units of government.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 寺院
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 佛教宗教活动场所，供僧侣修行与信众朝拜。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Buddhist monasteries, nunneries, and chapels.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 祭祀场所
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 用于祭祀神灵或祖先的场所，含国家祭祀与民间祭祀。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Altars, state shrines, ancestral temples, and venues for official or popular sacrificial rites.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 交通设施
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 提供交通与驿传服务的设施。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Ferry crossings, wharfs, post stations, and other non-bridge transportation infrastructure.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 学校
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 教育与考试机构及其内部建筑。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Imperial academies, prefectural schools, county schools, private academies, and charity schools.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 宫殿
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 皇室居住与理政场所。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Imperial palaces, throne halls, and royal residential buildings within the palace enclosure.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 园林
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 供游览休憩的景观区域与建筑群。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Imperial pleasure gardens, private landscape gardens, and public scenic parks.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 道观
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 道教宗教活动场所，用于奉祀神祇与仪式。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Taoist religious establishments, abbeys, and meditation compounds.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 经济活动设施
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 进行经济活动与仓储交易的场所。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Markets, warehouses, workshops, kilns, tax collection offices, and trade-related facilities.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 府邸宅邸
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 官员或富人的私人住宅，体现地位与居住文化。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Private mansions, noble compounds, and high-official dwellings (non-imperial).

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 山脉
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 自然地理中的山体与相关地貌单元。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Named mountains, hills, ridges, peaks, and other elevated landforms.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 城市内部区划
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 城市内部的行政或功能分区。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Wards, quarters, and named functional zones within the city walls, below the county level.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 桥梁
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 跨越水域或障碍的建筑，连接交通要道。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Named bridges spanning rivers, canals, and moats, including timber, stone, and pontoon types.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 水系
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 自然或人工水体。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Rivers, lakes, canals, ponds, streams, and other named natural or artificial water bodies.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 军事设施
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 用于军事目的的设施与编制相关实体。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: City walls, gates, passes, barracks, garrisons, naval stations, and fortifications.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 古迹
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 历史遗留建筑或遗址。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Archaeological remains, abandoned structures, historic ruins, and heritage landmarks no longer in original use.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 民居
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 普通百姓的居住场所。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Common residential buildings specifically documented in the sources by name or location.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 街道
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 城市道路网络与相关街区名，构成城市骨架。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Named streets, alleys, covered arcades, and imperial avenues within the city.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 乡镇
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 基层行政区划或聚居点。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Rural townships, market towns, and sub-county settlements outside the city walls.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 暂殡处所
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 王室贵族的暂时安葬之所，多设于寺院内。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Provisional imperial coffin resting places, often housed within Buddhist monasteries.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 水利设施
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 水资源管理与利用工程，保障灌溉与防洪。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Dams, sluice gates, embankments, weirs, and irrigation works for water management.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 市民生活
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 市民日常商业与娱乐活动场所。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entertainment theatres, teahouses, wine houses, bathhouses, and communal public spaces.

ENTITY_CATEGORIES.label: 社会福利设施
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 提供社会救助与福利的场所，照顾弱势群体。
ENTITY_CATEGORIES.description_en: Poorhouses, orphanages, charity granaries, public infirmaries, and relief institutions.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 位于
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1的地理位置在地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is spatially situated at or within Entity B (general location).

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 旧址位于
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示一个地理实体1的旧址位于地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: The original location of Entity A was at the place of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 改建
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1被改建为地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A was constructed by renovating or repurposing Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 包含
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示一个地理实体1包含地理实体2，其中大的地名地理实体1，小的放在地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A (larger) geographically encloses or incorporates Entity B (smaller) as a component.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 隶属
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1隶属于地理实体2。小的地名放在地理实体1，大的放在地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A (smaller) administratively or institutionally belongs to Entity B (larger).

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 别名
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1的别名是地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity B is a concurrent colloquial, literary, or unofficial name for Entity A.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 旧名
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1的旧名是地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A was previously called Entity B (B is the earlier name).

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 更名
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1的名称更改为地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A was officially renamed and thereafter called Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 距离
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1和地理实体2之间有距离关系，即文中明确描述距离多少。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: A measured or stated distance separates Entity A from Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 迁移
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示一个地理实体1迁移到地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A was physically moved from its original location to the site of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 相邻
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示两个地理实体相邻。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A and Entity B share a boundary or are immediately next to each other.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 交界
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示两个地理实体的边界相交。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Two administrative or geographic regions share a demarcated boundary line.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 起点
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 示地理实体1的起点是地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A (a route, river, or linear structure) has its origin at Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 终点
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1的终点是地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A (a route, river, or linear structure) has its terminus at Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 交汇
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1与地理实体2交汇在一起。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Two waterways or roads meet or merge at a common point.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 通往
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1通往地理实体2。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: A road, waterway, or route runs from Entity A toward or terminating at Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（东）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的东边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the east of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（南）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的南边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the south of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（西）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的西边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the west of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（北）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的北边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the north of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（内）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的内部。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A (smaller) is situated inside the boundary or enclosure of Entity B (larger). Direction is opposite to 'contains'.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（外）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的外部。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is situated outside the boundary or enclosure of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（左）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的左边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is positioned to the left of Entity B from a standard orientation.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（右）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的右边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is positioned to the right of Entity B from a standard orientation.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（上）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的上边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is above, upstream of, or at a higher elevation than Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（下）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的下边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is below, downstream of, or at a lower elevation than Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（前）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的前边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is positioned before or to the south-facing side of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（后）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的后边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is positioned to the rear or north-facing side of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（侧）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的侧边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is at the side of Entity B without specifying left or right.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（东北）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的东北边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the northeast of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（东南）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的东南边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the southeast of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（西南）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的西南边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the southwest of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（西北）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示地理实体1在地理实体2的西北边。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A is located to the northwest of Entity B.

RELATION_CATEGORIES.label: 方位关系（相对）
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_zh: 表示两个地理实体相对，即文中明确提到相对。
RELATION_CATEGORIES.description_en: Entity A directly faces or is across a space from Entity B.
